eyebrow.zh: 一条命令 · 不靠 LLM · 真 registry
eyebrow.en: One command · No LLM · Real registries

headline.zh:
粘一篇论文
红绿表点出每条编造的引用
headline.en:
Paste a paper
A red/green table flags every fabricated citation

sub.zh: DOI、arXiv、CVE、commit、issue 一次性核验到 OpenAlex、Crossref、arXiv、NVD、GitHub——不靠 LLM，宁可漏报也不误报红条。
sub.en: Every DOI, arXiv ID, CVE, commit, and issue is verified against OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, NVD, and GitHub at once — no LLM, would rather miss than false-alarm.

title.zh: 一条命令，红绿表说清每条引用真假
title.en: One command, a red/green verdict on every citation

body.zh: 粘 PDF / .tex / .md：绿勾=真 registry 命中并带证据链接，红叉=找不到且给最多 3 个最接近候选，黄问号=超时或限流。
body.en: Paste a PDF / .tex / .md: green check = real registry hit with an evidence link; red cross = not found, with up to 3 nearest matches; yellow = timeout or rate-limit.

title.zh: CI 里每个 PR 自动核验

body.zh: 把 GitHub Action 放进仓库，改 .pdf / .tex / .md 的 PR 自动跑核验，红绿报告贴在 PR 评论上，按 miss / degraded 阈值决定是否挂掉。
body.en: Drop the GitHub Action in and every PR touching .pdf / .tex / .md runs a check, posts a sticky red/green comment, and fails the build on your miss / degraded threshold.

title.zh: 五类标识符 × 五个真 registry
title.en: Five identifier types × five real registries

body.zh: DOI、arXiv、CVE、commit SHA、owner/repo#issue 一次性打到 OpenAlex、Crossref、arXiv、NVD、GitHub——并发跑、退避重试、7 天缓存兜底。
body.en: DOI, arXiv ID, CVE, commit SHA, owner/repo#issue — fanned out to OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, NVD, and GitHub at once, with backoff and a 7-day cache.

body.zh: 抽取只走正则、不调用 LLM，宁可漏报也不误报红条；同时落一份 schema 稳定的 JSON 边车，给 desk-reject 流水线直接消费。
body.en: Extraction runs on regex alone — no LLM — and would rather miss than false-alarm. A stable-schema JSON sidecar drops alongside for your desk-reject pipeline to consume.

headline.zh: 投稿前，先让 registry 说话
headline.en: Before you submit, let the registries speak

sub.zh: 一条命令装上，本地或 CI 都能跑。
sub.en: One command to install — runs locally or in CI.

tag.zh: 一条命令的引文核验工具
